requirements.text: 2+ years of hands-on experience developing enterprise applications.
Advanced degree in computer science or financial engineering, with strong programming skills.
Demonstrated Software Development skills, including designing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and supporting reliable application components.
Experience developing server-side services and applying enterprise integration patterns.
Ability to use Analytical Thinking and Problem Solving to evaluate technical challenges, identify effective solutions, and make sound implementation decisions.
Ability to learn a diverse technology stack and deliver solutions with a strong Customer Orientation.
Experience implementing software quality, security, testing, and production-support practices.
Ability to collaborate across business and technology teams while adapting to changing delivery priorities.
Full-Stack Development experience, including Java, Spring-based services, and Angular user-interface development.
Experience developing and deploying cloud-ready applications using Pivotal Cloud Foundry or a similar platform.
Experience with Microservices and event-driven or messaging technologies such as Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.
Experience with Data Science or data-platform engineering using Python, R, or MATLAB.
Experience with SQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Hadoop, data migration, or data-pipeline implementation.
Experience building data visualizations with Python and Plotly Dash.
Working knowledge of DevOps, GitHub, Bamboo, continuous integration, continuous deployment, containerization, or orchestration.
Understanding of Agile Fundamentals, behavior-driven development, test-driven development, and software design patterns.
Experience reviewing technical designs with architects and mentoring junior developers.
Demonstrated Adaptability, Attention to Detail, Curiosity, Communication, and Cross-Functional Collaboration.
